description: Regional facade styles for the trim-sheet atlas (ADR-020). The selection boxes are a coarse rule on the map centre, not a country lookup: the first box that holds the centre wins, else default_style. map.json "facades": {"style": "<name>"} overrides it. A style whose atlas is null keeps the per-material facade path until its atlas exists.

selection.note: Paris inside the Boulevard Périphérique, with a margin (plan Q3)
Mediterranean basin and Iberia, the Maghreb, the Levant and western Turkey, the Canary Islands, coastal California
Britain and Ireland, the United States, Canada, Australia, New Zealand
Mexico, Central America, the Caribbean and South America
From the Alps and the Rhine to the Vistula and the Carpathians

mediterranean.note: Rendered plaster in warm tones over a stone zocalo, a string course at every floor, a moulded cornice under the parapet, stone window surrounds, roller shutters (persianas) and panelled wooden doors.

central_european.note: Planned: pastel render over a rusticated ground floor, window aediculae, a deep cornice, casement windows without shutters.

anglo.note: Planned: brick in Flemish bond, painted sash windows, stone lintels and sills, a rendered or stone ground floor on shops.

latin_american.note: Planned: bright lime-washed render, a painted zocalo band, iron window grilles, flat parapets.

haussmann.note: Paris (plan Q3): light limestone ashlar on every storey, a stone plinth, a cornice and a string course at every storey, tall casements in painted or dark grey frames. Opt-in atlas in facade_styles.regional.json. Wrought-iron balconies and zinc mansards are geometry and not drawn yet.

generic.note: No regional atlas: the per-material facade path.
